The '''Togatto volcano''' was a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] located near [[Nurrale]], [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. The [[Togatto Speedway/Legends|Togatto Speedway]] passed through the core of the volcano.<ref name="CatCW" />
